CA.rationale: Candidate content (red set) is paired with a processing/origin field (executed_branch_claim) at the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n0 the content (red set) and an explicit origin/presentation status (completed_record) are present and separable.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Processing/allocation language ('peaks') and explicit origin processing flag (executed_branch_claim:false) are linked to candidate contents.

C.rationale: Report lists identified contents (red/blue) with explicit referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Content entries (red sets) are presented alongside distinct origin/status fields (completed_record, executed_branch_claim), separating identification from status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Origin fields and the 'peaks' statement describe how contents are presented/emerge/accessed (current vs candidate).
